findings.current: “That is why I said you didn’t need permission.”
findings.defect: The subject is reversed. Mungyeong says that he does not need Taekyung’s permission, not that Taekyung does not need permission.
findings.rationale: 네놈 허락은 필요 없다 explicitly means that Mungyeong has no need for Taekyung’s permission.
findings.replacement: “Like I said, I don’t need your permission.”
findings.source: “그래서 말했을 텐데. 네놈 허락은 필요 없다고.”

findings.defect: The draft sanitizes Taekyung’s profane reaction.
findings.rationale: 시벌 is a deliberately distorted but unmistakable form of strong profanity; “hell” weakens its register.

findings.defect: The draft explains the joke rather than preserving Taekyung’s mock-grandiose phrasing and deadpan timing.
findings.rationale: 무려 ironically emphasizes the supposedly impressive number of six; the concise phrasing carries the humor.

findings.current: “Why would he leave the Sword Saint and deliberately learn from someone with such a foul temper—sorry. That came out wrong.”
findings.defect: The plain title “Sword Saint” omits the comic, exaggerated praise in 킹갓검성.
findings.rationale: 킹갓 is humorous hyperbolic praise, contrasting the Sword Saint with Mungyeong immediately before Taekyung insults Mungyeong’s temperament.
findings.replacement: “Why would he pass up the almighty Sword Saint and go out of his way to learn from someone with such a foul temper—sorry. That came out wrong.”
findings.source: “아니, 왜 킹갓검성을 놔두고 굳이 성격도 더러운…… 죄송합니다. 말이 헛나왔네요.”

findings.defect: The draft renders the idiom literally and loses Mungyeong’s surprise that he has witnessed something so unexpected.
findings.rationale: 오래 살고 볼 일이다 is an idiomatic reaction to an astonishing or unprecedented development, not a factual statement about age.

findings.current: Even so, it was the last time. Couldn’t they at least come to see my face?
findings.defect: “The last time” implies a permanent final meeting, while the source means the last opportunity before Taekyung departs. The plural pronoun also obscures that he is waiting for Jeok Cheongang.
findings.rationale: 마지막인데 refers contextually to Taekyung’s imminent departure, and the preceding reflection identifies Jeok Cheongang as the person whose absence disappoints him.
findings.replacement: Still, this was the last chance before I left. Couldn’t he at least come see me?
findings.source: 그래도 마지막인데 얼굴 정도는 보러 와 주지.

findings.current:
—Do you know? Everyone who has received my teachings up to now has died.

“…”
findings.defect: The missing exclamation mark removes Taekyung’s explicit shock at Mungyeong’s statement.
findings.rationale: The source punctuates the silent reaction with an exclamation mark, marking a startled response rather than an uninflected pause.
findings.replacement:
—Do you know? Everyone who has received my teachings up to now has died.

“…!”
findings.source:
- 그거 아느냐? 지금까지 내 가르침을 받은 놈들은 모두 죽었다.

“……!”

findings.current: —So don’t die a pointless death. If you die in Nanman, all the restraint I’ve shown until now will have been for nothing.
findings.defect: “The restraint I’ve shown” suggests Mungyeong has refrained from acting, whereas 참은 것 means everything he has endured or put up with during Taekyung’s instruction.
findings.rationale: The line expresses Mungyeong’s gruff concern through the sunk cost of what he has endured, not through self-restraint.
findings.replacement: —So don’t die a pointless death. If you die in Nanman, all that I’ve put up with until now will have been for nothing.
findings.source: - 그러니 헛되이 죽지 말거라. 네놈이 남만에서 죽어 버리면, 내가 지금까지 참은 것이 아까워지니까.

summary: One subject reversal, one misleading departure implication, and several localized losses of humor, register, and characterization.
